selection_and_thresholds: Reuse the exact ten IDs and thresholds from tolerance_trial_10_v1; no resampling or retuning.
controls: Filter candidate spans BEFORE overlap selection; compare also a post-selection veto as ablation.
Whole word boundaries required; punctuation/spacing outside corrections is copied unchanged.
Function words inside a source span must match the canonical function-word sequence, preserving by/of/with/etc. Nearby negation outside the span is retained, not used to block valid spelling repair.
Literal quantities, number words, unit symbols and negation signature inside each proposed replacement must remain identical.
Recognized opposed qualifiers and grammatical-number alternatives cannot be substituted.

Token alignment consumes every source and target token. Adjacent fragments may be merged only as spelling repair; if one fragment already matches the target at >=0.85 similarity, reject adding another word unless the concatenation is exactly the target.
Per-token similarity floor 0.65 and at least one unchanged lexical anchor of >=3 characters; fixed before evaluating new contexts.
comparison: Same thresholds with preselection context/boundary controls
development_scope: The previous by failure motivated these rules. The reused speech corpus is development/regression evidence, not a new independent holdout. New constructed contexts do not establish speech or clinical accuracy.
